name: PLU NxN 2022

venue.name: Chris Knutzen Hall - Pacific Lutheran University
venue.details: Competition tables in Knutzen Hall (Room 214) in the Anderson University Center. Extra waiting tables in Regency (203) .

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PLUNxN2022#17389-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Please also be sure to review the [Health and Safety](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PLUNxN2022#17388-health-and-safety) tab to check additional COVID-19 requirements for this competition.

Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) to hear about competitions in the Pacific Northwest before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
